chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me of it, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from some of our companions, from al-Tayalisi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:
The kaffarah of menstruation is that he gives charity: if it was at its beginning, then one dinar; in its middle, half a dinar; and at its end, a quarter dinar.

I said: What if he does not have what he may offer as kaffarah? He said: Then let him give charity to one needy person; otherwise, let him seek Allah’s forgiveness and not return to it, for seeking forgiveness is tawbah and a kaffarah for everyone who does not find a way to anything of the kaffarah.

key_terms.بِدِينَارٍ: one dinar as a monetary expiation
key_terms.رُبُعَ دِينَارٍ: a quarter dinar as the expiation at the end stage
key_terms.مِسْكِينٍ: a needy person who may receive charity
key_terms.نِصْفَ دِينَارٍ: half a dinar as a reduced expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for intercourse during menstruation according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith states the kaffarah for intercourse with a menstruating woman, with the amount varying according to whether it occurred at the beginning, middle, or end of menstruation. If one cannot afford the prescribed kaffarah, he should give charity to a single needy person, and if unable even to do that, he should seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent.
